decision: Do not fold task_create and task_update into a task_upsert. A task update is guarded by a claim token and a create is not, and task_create has its own similar-task check (ifSimilar); one upsert would mix two different contracts. note, feature and milestone keep their upsert tools.
title: Keep task_create and task_update separate from the *_upsert tools (review 12.6)
